hero.purpose: The hero headline only, cream on a hard navy edge over the sky.

headline.purpose: How to Play, Fair Game Rules, FAQ, the closing question and the footer line.

caps.purpose: The hero line, FAQ group names, the seal's line; Cinzel also sets step numbers, rule titles and Roman numerals.

body.purpose: The page default; cards, rules and FAQ answers use 1.0625rem.

small-body.purpose: How to Play cards, rules and FAQ answers, held to 34-42rem.

shadows.name: hard-edge
shadows.purpose: Play Now and the round buttons: the logo's pressed look. Hover deepens it, press flattens it.

shadows.name: frame-rings
shadows.value: 0 0 0 0.4rem var(--box-deep), 0 0 0 calc(0.4rem + 1px) var(--foil-lo), 0 24px 60px color-mix(in srgb, var(--box-deep) 70%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: The gold frames (How to Play paintings, battle loop).

shadows.name: gold-glow
shadows.purpose: The How to Play timeline, crown and closing line only.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: Play Now and round buttons: 2px lift on hover, press down on click.

motion.name: howto-scroll
motion.purpose: How to Play: transform and opacity only, reversible with scrolling; autoplay glides through the steps.

motion.name: scroll-unroll
motion.value: 1.9-3s scaled by height (1.6ms/px), cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.3, 1); close 900ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)
motion.purpose: The Fair Game Rules scroll opens on arrival and rolls shut on leaving.

motion.name: faq-slide
motion.purpose: FAQ answers slide open where interpolate-size is supported.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No pinning, autoplay, unrolling or slides; everything shown at once.

narrative.northStar: A Painted Kingdom in Navy and Gold
narrative.overview: The landing page tells Funge as a painted medieval world. It opens in the daylight sky over the valley painting, then falls into night navy, trimmed in gold the way the Funge logo is: cream letters on a hard navy edge, with crown gold. It is a sequence of scenes: the hero, the pinned How to Play on the dusk battlefield, the battle loop in a gold frame, the Fair Game Rules on a parchment scroll between painted rollers, the FAQ, and King Satoshi on his throne. Scope: the landing page only (index.html at /); the game page (play/index.html at /play/) keeps its own look.
keyCharacteristics: Night-navy ground, gold trim and cream type, all taken from the logo.
The game's own paintings carry the scenes: the valley, the dusk field, the How to Play paintings, the roller, the throne.
Grenze Gotisch for headings, Cinzel capitals for labels and numerals, Alegreya Sans for reading.
One gold button, Play Now, in the hero, at the end of How to Play and in the footer.
Scroll-driven motion that plays back in reverse; everything shown and open under reduced motion.
Self-hosted fonts and the game's own art; icons as inline SVG.

rules.name: The Logo Colour Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons and round controls use the logo's own cream, navy and gold. New controls take these three before anything else.

rules.name: The One Light Surface Rule
rules.body: Below the hero, the parchment scroll is the only light surface, and its text is navy ink. Everything else is navy with cream text.

rules.name: The Gold Is Trim Rule
rules.body: Gold is a border, a line, an icon, a numeral or the Play Now face. It is never a large background area.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Cream headings on navy or sky carry the logo's hard navy edge (text-shadow 0 0.055em 0 logo-navy); on the painting a soft glow is added.

rules.name: The Reading Width Rule
rules.body: Reading text is held to about 34rem in cards and the rules, and 42rem in FAQ answers.

rules.name: The Gold Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow is reserved for the How to Play timeline and its crown. Nothing else glows.

dos: Do take colours for new headings and controls from the logo: cream, navy, gold.
Do give cream headings the logo's hard navy edge.
Do keep Play Now the only gold-faced button; every other control is a navy disc or panel with gold trim.
Do frame paintings and video in the gold frame with corner flourishes.
Do keep touch targets at least 2.75rem and a visible focus outline (3px foil-hi, 3px offset).
Do keep motion on transform and opacity, reversible with scrolling, and static under reduced motion.
Do take every word from COPY.landing in src/copy.ts and every rule number from the rule constants.
Do use self-hosted fonts and the game's own art; draw icons as inline SVG.
donts: Don't add a second light surface below the hero; the parchment is the only one.
Don't use gold as a large background, or glow anything outside the How to Play timeline.
Don't put a hard border or frame around the throne painting; it fades into the page.
Don't load the game's code (libauth, Phaser, src/lib/kingdom.ts) into the landing page.
Don't apply this system to the game page (play/index.html, src/battlefield/) without a separate decision.
